```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/election2016.csv"
election2016=read.csv(df_url)
names(election2016[,2:9])
```

```{r}
library(leaps)
fit_regsubsets=regsubsets(trump.vote~.,
                          data=election2016[,2:10],
                          nvmax=NULL)
summary(fit_regsubsets)
```

```{r}
sum_regsubsets=summary(fit_regsubsets)
```

```{r}
plot(sum_regsubsets$bic)
coef(fit_regsubsets,id=which.min(sum_regsubsets$bic))
```
